reviews.name: Lauren Ferguson
reviews.text: I am so excited for this new book release!! Leameso is very passionate when it comes to her work, so I know that “The Beautiful Beast” will be a hit! ❤️

reviews.name: Ms. Mimi
reviews.text: So far I am so intrigued about "The Beautiful Beast" written by Ms Leameso James. I can barely contain myself. I am absolutely ready to embark on this stormy journey. Everybody get on board with you.
